assertion_results.text: Version resolution detects the existing Affects Version/s value and presents it to the user (Step 4.5.1)

assertion_results.text: Version resolution offers three options: Keep, Replace, or Augment the existing value (Step 4.5.1)
assertion_results.evidence: version-resolution.md lines 16-19 present exactly three options: '1. Keep -- leave the current value and skip to Step 5', '2. Replace -- clear and set a new value', '3. assertion_results.text: The skill does NOT silently overwrite or skip the existing value — it waits for user input (Step 4.5.1)
